title: Island map: pool, shops and coast
question: Does island-02 have the layout you want, or what should move?

options.label: island-02
options.note: More offices, a shopping area, a pool, an onsen and a beach. Honsha station connects to head office; IT remains on B2. Open the labelled viewer for district views, location pins, full prompts and every attempt. Reviewers noted that the shop architecture reads more like a seaside village than a Japanese shopping street.

options.label: revise-layout
options.note: Keep this as a draft. Tell us which places or connections should change.

links.label: Labelled maps, zoom and every attempt

decision: Fine for inspiration and general layout, can't build on it yet: pool needs a shower building, onsen separate gendered areas, shopping street less disjointed/cutesy, apartments more attached and clustered, less idyllic
